notes.title: MINOR UPDATE 2019/07/22
notes.content:
-Simplified the ESC Menu and clarified the function of the Main Menu Button.

Pressing ESC->Exit to Main Menu will save your game and then exit to the Main Menu. In order to return to playing the game you left, you will need to press the Load Game button and enter your profile name.

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE 2019/07/20
notes.content:
-Added a toggle for V-Synch.

The V-Synch option can be found by pressing ESC->Options. Checking the box will enable V-Synch. This feature limits your FPS to your monitor's vertical refresh rate (typically 60 FPS but may be higher or lower depending on your hardware).
